description: This file is the header (.h) interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service, defining function prototypes related to message bus engagement, initialization, resource management, signal sending, and message handling within the CCSP environment for embedded Linux.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus for a specific component with given configuration.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus status.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_GetHealth
methods.description: Retrieves the health status of the message bus or related service.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a transfer operation has completed.

methods.name: CcspTandD_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming messages on a given DBus connection.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the interface with the Configuration Repository.

methods.name: ssp_XdnsMbi_WaitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until the bus condition or component is ready.
